mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,contact_name,contact_phone,region,detail,is_default,status FROM user_address WHERE id=#{addressId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,user_id,contact_name,contact_phone,region,detail,is_default,status FROM user_address WHERE user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY is_default DESC, created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_address WHERE user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET contact_name=#{contactName},contact_phone=#{contactPhone},region=#{region},detail=#{detail},is_default=#{isDefault}, version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE user_address SET status='DELETED',is_default=0,version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{addressId} AND user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE user_address SET is_default=1,version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{addressId} AND user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE user_address SET is_default=0,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND is_default=1 AND id<>#{keepAddressId} AND status='ACTIVE'
